SELECT w.status, w.fulfilment_type, w.login_state, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) d, sum(w.line_count) lines, sum(w.order_total_gross) gross,
 count(s.receipt_id) FILTER (WHERE true) matched_lines
FROM fact_web_order w LEFT JOIN (SELECT receipt_id, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) GROUP BY 1) x ON x.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3)) s ON s.receipt_id=w.web_order_id
WHERE CAST(w.order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(refund_gross) g, min(return_ts_utc), max(return_ts_utc)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id>=900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.return_date, f.channel_id, s.store_id rs, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) d, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, sum(f.net_amount) orig_net
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND (f.channel_id IN (2,3) OR s.store_id>=900 OR f.sales_line_id IS NULL) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'neg_or_zero' k, count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND (net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_stg_ids', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL SELECT 'ts_vs_date_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE) <> sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'orders_no_lines', count(*) FROM fact_web_order w WHERE status<>'cancelled' AND CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=w.web_order_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_no_orders', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE f.receipt_id=w.web_order_id)

calls.statement:
WITH web AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3)),
rets AS (SELECT r.* FROM fact_return_line r JOIN web w USING(sales_line_id))
SELECT 'multi_return_lines' k, count(*) v FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM rets GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'over_return', count(*) FROM rets r JOIN web w USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.quantity_returned>w.quantity OR r.refund_net>w.net_amount+0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_ids', count(*)-count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM rets
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_before_sale', count(*) FROM rets r JOIN web w USING(sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date<w.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_return_overlap', count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load s JOIN rets USING(return_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_return_total', count(*) FROM stg_return_line_load

calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT sale_date AS business_date, sum(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2, 3) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS returns_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date AS business_date, s.net_sales_before_returns, coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS returns_net,
       s.net_sales_before_returns - coalesce(r.returns_net, 0) AS net_sales
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN web_sales s ON s.business_date = d.calendar_date LEFT JOIN web_returns r ON r.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' ORDER BY 1
